data.title: Seagate at Rashid Yachts & Marina
data.about:
Welcome to Seagate at Rashid Yachts & Marina. Housing 4 buildings with stunning 1 – 4 bedroom apartments, they overlook the marina and serving beautiful views of the waters. 

Come home to aesthetic luxury and amenities like no other place. This property is home to tranquility and peace and is located just minutes from the major attractions in the city. Live by the 500-metre-long Canal Pool with a grand promenade, which is surrounded by Palm trees and cabanas.

location_tile.title: Live in an ideal location by Dubai’s stunning waterfront homes.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Just minutes from the city’s major attractions, with Downtown Dubai just a short drive from here.

  • 12 mins – Dubai International Airport
  • 14 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 22 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 26 mins – Palm Jumeirah
